stations.name: BBC Radio 1
stations.notes: BBC retired plain MP3/SHOUTcast in Oct 2023. Only HLS (.m3u8) and MPEG-DASH remain. A VS1053 cannot decode HLS directly (it needs a continuous MP3/AAC stream, not a segmented manifest). Needs either a transcoding relay on the Pi 5 (ffmpeg re-muxing HLS -> plain MP3/AAC on a local port) or drop this station from v1.

stations.name: BBC Radio 2

stations.name: BBC Radio 6 Music
stations.notes: Same HLS-only issue as BBC Radio 1.

stations.name: BBC World Service
stations.notes: Confirmed DEAD on the Pi 5 (2026-07-24) -- server returns HTTP 410 Gone. The legacy mediaselector endpoint has been formally retired, not just quietly rotted. This station now needs the same HLS-relay treatment as the domestic BBC stations (see bbc_radio_1 notes) -- it's not a plain-MP3 exception after all.

stations.name: Jazz FM

Needs manual lookup (browser dev tools, Network tab, filter for media on planetradio.co.uk/jazz-fm).

stations.name: Absolute Radio 80s
stations.notes: Previous mount (icy-e-bab-04-cr.sharp-stream.com) confirmed dead 2026-07-24. New working mount found via radiofeeds.co.uk's bauerflash.pls redirector, resolved with curl -A "VLC/3.0.18 LibVLC/3.0.18". URL includes a query-string session key/player-id (aw_0_1st.skey, aw_0_1st.playerid) -- worth re-checking periodically in case this expires or rotates, unlike the plain media-ice.musicradio.com mounts which have no such parameters.

stations.name: Absolute Radio Country
stations.notes: Previous mount (edge-bauerall-01-gos2.sharp-stream.com/absolutecountry.aac) confirmed dead 2026-07-24 (ConnectError). New working mp3 mount found via radiofeeds.co.uk's bauerflash.pls redirector, same method as absolute_80s. URL includes a query-string session key/player-id -- worth re-checking periodically in case it expires or rotates. Jazz FM tried via the same redirector pattern (station=jazzfm-mp3) but returned 404 on two separate fresh keys -- confirms Jazz FM has no live direct mount right now, not a token-expiry issue; stays unresolved, only the Rayo app player is available.
